UpdateSourceArgs: -c "set -e; cd q2pro; if [[ ! -d source/.git ]]; then git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/q2pro/q2pro.git source; else git -C source fetch --depth 1 origin master && git -C source reset --hard origin/master; fi; rm -rf build; meson setup -Dsystem-wide=false -Dlibpng=disabled -Dlibjpeg=disabled -Dlibcurl=disabled -Dsdl2=disabled -Dopenal=disabled -Davcodec=disabled -Dsoftware-sound=disabled -Dx11=disabled -Dwayland=disabled build source; meson compile -C build q2proded gamex86_64; mkdir -p server/baseq2; cp -f build/q2proded server/q2proded; chmod +x server/q2proded; if [[ -f build/gamex86_64.so ]]; then cp -f build/gamex86_64.so server/baseq2/gamex86_64.so; fi; echo 'Q2PRO dedicated server built.'"

-c "set -e; mkdir -p q2pro/server/baseq2/maps; CFG=q2pro/server/baseq2/amp-server.cfg; if [[ ! -f \"$CFG\" ]]; then printf '%s\n' 'set hostname \"AMP Powered Quake II\"' 'set maxclients \"16\"' 'set password \"\"' 'set rcon_password \"\"' 'set public \"1\"' 'set deathmatch \"1\"' 'set coop \"0\"' 'set fraglimit \"30\"' 'set timelimit \"15\"' 'set dmflags \"0\"' 'set sv_maplist \"q2dm1 q2dm2 q2dm3 q2dm4 q2dm5 q2dm6 q2dm7 q2dm8\"' 'set allow_download \"1\"' 'set allow_download_maps \"2\"' 'set allow_download_models \"1\"' 'set allow_download_sounds \"1\"' 'set allow_download_players \"0\"' 'set sv_downloadserver \"\"' 'set sv_fps \"10\"' 'set logfile \"2\"' 'setmaster master.q2servers.com master.quakeservers.net netdome.biz' > \"$CFG\"; fi; if [[ -f \"$CFG\" ]]; then sed -i '/^[[:space:]]*set[[:space:]]\\+sys_console[[:space:]]/d' \"$CFG\"; fi"

-c "set -e; cd q2pro; if [[ ! -d modsrc/wod/.git ]]; then mkdir -p modsrc; git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/ulatekh/quake2-WOD.git modsrc/wod; else git -C modsrc/wod fetch --depth 1 origin master && git -C modsrc/wod reset --hard origin/master; fi; make -C modsrc/wod clean; make -C modsrc/wod; mkdir -p server/weapons; cp -a modsrc/wod/resources/. server/weapons/; cp -f modsrc/wod/release/game.so server/weapons/gamex86_64.so; chmod +x server/weapons/gamex86_64.so; printf '%s\n' 'Source: https://github.com/ulatekh/quake2-WOD' 'Installed by AMPGameServer from the maintained Weapons of Destruction source tree.' > server/weapons/AMP-PROVENANCE.txt; echo 'Weapons of Destruction installed to game directory: weapons'"

-c "set -e; cd q2pro; TMP=modtmp/aqtion; rm -rf \"$TMP\"; mkdir -p \"$TMP\" server/action; API=$(wget -qO- https://api.github.com/repos/actionquake/distrib/releases/latest); URL=$(printf '%s' \"$API\" | grep -o 'https://github.com/actionquake/distrib/releases/download/[^\"[:space:]]*linux-x86_64.zip' | head -n 1); test -n \"$URL\"; echo \"Downloading $URL\"; wget -q --show-progress -O \"$TMP.zip\" \"$URL\"; unzip -q \"$TMP.zip\" -d \"$TMP\"; ROOT=$(find \"$TMP\" -maxdepth 2 -type d -name aqtion | head -n 1); test -n \"$ROOT\"; if [[ -d \"$ROOT/baseaq\" ]]; then cp -a \"$ROOT/baseaq/.\" server/action/; fi; cp -a \"$ROOT/action/.\" server/action/; chmod +x server/action/gamex86_64.so 2>/dev/null || true; printf '%s\n' \"Source release: $URL\" 'Installed from the official Action Quake II / AQtion Linux x86_64 release.' > server/action/AMP-PROVENANCE.txt; rm -rf \"$TMP\" \"$TMP.zip\"; echo 'AQtion installed to game directory: action'"

-c "set -e; cd q2pro; if [[ ! -d modsrc/3zb2/.git ]]; then mkdir -p modsrc; git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/yquake2/3zb2.git modsrc/3zb2; else git -C modsrc/3zb2 fetch --depth 1 origin master && git -C modsrc/3zb2 reset --hard origin/master; fi; make -C modsrc/3zb2 clean; make -C modsrc/3zb2; unzip -q -o modsrc/3zb2/misc/assets.zip -d server; mkdir -p server/3zb2; cp -f modsrc/3zb2/release/game.so server/3zb2/gamex86_64.so; chmod +x server/3zb2/gamex86_64.so; cp -f modsrc/3zb2/README.md server/3zb2/README-upstream.md; printf '%s\n' 'Source: https://github.com/yquake2/3zb2' '3rd Zigock Bot II port maintained for modern Quake II engines.' > server/3zb2/AMP-PROVENANCE.txt; echo '3ZB2 installed. Spawn bots from console with: sv spb <count>'"

-c "set -e; cd q2pro; command -v unzip >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'ERROR: unzip is not installed in this AMP container. Recreate the instance after fetching the latest template so ExtraContainerPackages are applied.'; exit 10; }; if [[ ! -d modsrc/freezetag/.git ]]; then mkdir -p modsrc; git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/dbircsak/freeze-tag.git modsrc/freezetag; else git -C modsrc/freezetag fetch --depth 1 origin master && git -C modsrc/freezetag reset --hard origin/master; fi; [[ -s modsrc/freezetag/freeze189.zip ]] || { echo 'ERROR: freeze189.zip is missing from the upstream Freeze Tag repository.'; exit 11; }; rm -rf modtmp/freeze-stage; mkdir -p modtmp/freeze-stage/assets modtmp/freeze-stage/final; unzip -q -o modsrc/freezetag/freeze189.zip -d modtmp/freeze-stage/assets; PKGDIR=$(find modtmp/freeze-stage/assets -type d -iname freeze | head -n 1); if [[ -n \"$PKGDIR\" ]]; then cp -a \"$PKGDIR/.\" modtmp/freeze-stage/final/; else cp -a modtmp/freeze-stage/assets/. modtmp/freeze-stage/final/; fi; SRC=modsrc/freezetag/quake2; sed -i 's/^static[[:space:]]*int[[:space:]]*jacket_armor_index;/int jacket_armor_index;/' \"$SRC/g_items.c\"; sed -i 's/^static[[:space:]]*int[[:space:]]*combat_armor_index;/int combat_armor_index;/' \"$SRC/g_items.c\"; sed -i 's/^static[[:space:]]*int[[:space:]]*body_armor_index;/int body_armor_index;/' \"$SRC/g_items.c\"; grep -q '^#include <stddef.h>$' \"$SRC/g_local.h\" || sed -i '1i#include <stddef.h>' \"$SRC/g_local.h\"; sed -i -E 's@^#define[[:space:]]+FOFS\(x\).*@#define FOFS(x) ((int)offsetof(edict_t, x))@; s@^#define[[:space:]]+STOFS\(x\).*@#define STOFS(x) ((int)offsetof(spawn_temp_t, x))@; s@^#define[[:space:]]+LLOFS\(x\).*@#define LLOFS(x) ((int)offsetof(level_locals_t, x))@; s@^#define[[:space:]]+CLOFS\(x\).*@#define CLOFS(x) ((int)offsetof(gclient_t, x))@' \"$SRC/g_local.h\"; cd \"$SRC\"; gcc -std=gnu89 -D_GNU_SOURCE -D__linux__ -fcommon -fPIC -shared -O2 -fno-strict-aliasing -Wno-implicit-function-declaration -Wno-int-conversion -o ../../../modtmp/freeze-stage/final/gamex86_64.so *.c -lm || { echo 'ERROR: Freeze Tag source failed to compile on this Linux toolchain.'; exit 12; }; cd ../../..; [[ -s modtmp/freeze-stage/final/gamex86_64.so ]] || { echo 'ERROR: Freeze Tag build did not produce gamex86_64.so.'; exit 13; }; chmod +x modtmp/freeze-stage/final/gamex86_64.so; cp -f modsrc/freezetag/LICENSE modtmp/freeze-stage/final/LICENSE-freeze-tag.txt; cp -f modsrc/freezetag/README.md modtmp/freeze-stage/final/README-upstream.md; printf '%s\n' 'Source: https://github.com/dbircsak/freeze-tag' 'Original player package: freeze189.zip' 'Linux x86_64 game module rebuilt from the original Quake II Freeze Tag source.' 'Build compatibility patches: armor index linkage + offsetof field offsets for modern x86_64 GCC.' > modtmp/freeze-stage/final/AMP-PROVENANCE.txt; rm -rf server/freeze; mv modtmp/freeze-stage/final server/freeze; rm -rf modtmp/freeze-stage; echo 'Freeze Tag 1.89 installed successfully to game directory: freeze'"

-c "set -e; mkdir -p q2pro/server/baseq2/maps; cd q2pro/server/baseq2/maps; ROOT='https://tastyspleen.net/~quake2/baseq2/maps'; for MAP in ztn2dm1.bsp ztn2dm2.bsp ztn2dm3.bsp ztn2dm4.bsp ztn2dm5.bsp ztndm3q2.bsp aerowalk.bsp q2rdm1.bsp q2rdm2.bsp q2rdm3.bsp q2rdm4.bsp q2rdm5.bsp q2rdm6.bsp; do [[ -s \"$MAP\" ]] || wget -q --show-progress -O \"$MAP.tmp\" \"$ROOT/$MAP\" && mv \"$MAP.tmp\" \"$MAP\" || rm -f \"$MAP.tmp\"; done"

-c "set -e; mkdir -p q2pro/server/baseq2/maps; cd q2pro/server/baseq2/maps; ROOT='https://tastyspleen.net/~quake2/baseq2/maps/'; wget -qO- \"$ROOT\" | grep -Eoi 'href=\"[^\"]+\\.bsp\"' | sed -E 's/^href=\"//; s/\"$//' | grep -vE '[/\\]' | sort -u | while IFS= read -r MAP; do [[ -z \"$MAP\" || -s \"$MAP\" ]] && continue; echo \"Downloading $MAP\"; wget -q -O \"$MAP.tmp\" \"${ROOT}${MAP}\" && mv \"$MAP.tmp\" \"$MAP\" || rm -f \"$MAP.tmp\"; done"
